recalls.summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Acura MDX, 2015-2019 Acura TLX and 2015-2017 Honda Accord vehicles, equipped with a 3.5L V6 engine.  Particulates in fuel may adhere to the internal components of the fuel pump, reducing its performance.

Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2013-2016 Honda Accord vehicles.  The case for the battery sensor, part of the battery management system, may allow water to get in, potentially causing an electrical short.
